diagnosis.summary: The nightly run d0d78b4c failed at ingest for partition 2026-10-01. Upstream now writes orders.order_total as a dollar string ("$4.99"), and the loader can't convert that to a decimal number. The column names are unchanged, and the stripped amounts match the payments amounts in the rows we sampled. I've proposed adding a strip_currency parser for orders.order_total at ingest. Redelivery isn't the fix, because it would just resend the same format. The fix is applied in the sandbox, followed by a rerun of 2026-10-01 and a check of row counts and revenue against prior days.

root_cause.explanation: Upstream changed how orders.order_total is formatted. It used to send plain numbers (14.99) and now sends dollar strings ($4.99). The ingest step has no parser set up, so its conversion to DECIMAL(12,2) fails. The header and the other tables are unchanged.

evidence.claim: Ingest failed because "$4.99" could not be converted to DECIMAL(12,2) from order_total
The 10-01 orders file has a $ prefix on order_total. The 09-30 file had plain numbers. Headers are identical.
With the $ removed, the sampled amounts match the payments amounts for the same orders, so the meaning hasn't changed
Nothing in the ingest config currently parses this column
The runbook says to handle a $-reformatted value with set_column_parser strip_currency, and says redelivery would only reproduce the format

alternatives_considered: request_upstream_redelivery: rejected because the format change looks persistent, so a redelivery would come back with the same $ values
escalate_to_owner upstream_app_team: not needed, since the meaning is unchanged (amounts match payments) and the runbook allows adapting at ingest
column rename or added column: ruled out because the headers match the contract
bad dbt model deploy: ruled out because the failure happened at ingest, before any dbt models ran

proposal.rationale: Upstream now formats orders.order_total with a "$" prefix ("$4.99"). The DECIMAL(12,2) cast fails at ingest. The header is unchanged, and once the symbol is stripped the sampled amounts match the payment amounts, so the meaning has not changed. The runbook says a reformatted numeric value should be adapted at ingest with set_column_parser strip_currency. Redelivery would just reproduce the format. After the fix, the 2026-10-01 partition must be rerun and its row counts and revenue checked against prior days.

applied: ingest now parses raw.orders.order_total with strip_currency
